summary: Kids coloring, drawing, learning, games, art, and educational activities!
description:
Crayola Create and Play is a fun and educational game for kids that provides hundreds of art, coloring, drawing and painting games and activities to inspire children's imagination. Crayola Create & Play provides a safe, supportive, and parent and teacher-approved environment for kids to develop self-expression, artistic independence, and confidence through art games and creative coloring and drawing activities. Crayola’s fun games for kids go beyond just drawing and coloring with crayons, with art activities that ignite children's imaginations and creativity and support cognitive development. Get unlimited access with your 7-day free trial. Cancel anytime.

ART, COLORING, AND DRAWING GAMES & ACTIVITIES FOR KIDS
• Explore kids’ creativity with unlimited coloring and drawing pages
• Create colorful pixel art unicorns, dogs, cats, dinosaurs, pets, and more
• Spark creativity and bright ideas with glow art coloring
• Color and create dinosaurs, rocket ships, and other craftables

ENCOURAGE CRITICAL THINKING & LEARN EDUCATIONAL CLASSROOM SKILLS
• Inspired by STEAM and STEM education techniques, Crayola helps kids learn through playing, drawing, coloring, painting, games, and creative art activities
• Coding exercises and creative games help your child grasp complex topics in science and math
• Practice spelling, number recognition, and watch colorful behind-the-scenes videos on how Crayola crayons are made
• Kids can solve puzzles they create from their own art, coloring, painting and drawing games!

CREATE DIGITAL MASTERPIECES WITH CRAYOLA ART TOOLS
• Kids use real Crayola art tools and crayons to color, draw, paint, stamp, sticker, glitter and create
• Encourage creativity with coloring, drawing, and painting for kids

PRACTICE KINDNESS & EMPATHY BY CARING FOR PETS
• Hatch, design, color, create, and interact with pets
• Combine coloring and drawing for kids with practicing empathy through pet 
  care like washing and feeding

PARENT & TEACHER APPROVED DRAWING AND COLORING APP
• Crayola creates educational and creative coloring fun for the whole family
• COPPA and PRIVO certified, and GDPR compliant so you can be sure the app is safe for kids
• Play with your children to watch them grow, learn and create

NEW KIDS GAMES & ART ACTIVITIES MONTHLY
• For toddlers, preschool age, pre- kindergarten age, and young children
• Ever-evolving content updates to keep children inspired and creative

WHY SUBSCRIBE TO THE CRAYOLA CREATE AND PLAY ART APP?
Unlock full access to all kids games, coloring games, creativity games, drawing games, new educational art activities and features, and monthly content updates!
